extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners (attorneys/agents) seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of a Petition for Reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline procedures (37 CFR § 11.58). Involves determining compliance with regulatory provisions and whether reinstatement is appropriate after review of the petition and the record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Bohanek appears to have complied with all provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance with the provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58 is a prerequisite considered by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline when evaluating a Petition for Reinstatement. The petition record should demonstrate satisfaction of those regulatory requirements (the page does not enumerate the specific subsection requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness after review of petition and record
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition and all information in the record material to Mr. Bohanek's eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond technical compliance with the regulation, reinstatement requires the Director to review the petition and all record information relevant to eligibility and to make a discretionary determination that reinstatement is appropriate; documentation and record evidence should support that determination.
